description: This Java source file defines the class 'PublicJsonExamplesProducer', which is a command-line utility for generating Markdown files containing JSON examples wrapped in Markdown syntax. It produces examples of Ditto protocol JSON snippets for documentation purposes, utilizing methods from related classes like 'JsonExamplesProducer' and 'DittoProtocolAdapter'. The class includes methods for finding matching 'toAdaptable' methods via reflection, wrapping exceptions in error responses, and writing JSON snippets with markdown formatting.

classes.name: PublicJsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class for generating JSON example snippets wrapped in Markdown syntax for documentation, specifically for Ditto protocol examples.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for execution; initializes the example producer based on command-line arguments and triggers the generation process.

methods.name: findMatchingToAdaptableMethod
methods.description: Uses reflection to find an 'toAdaptable' method in the protocol adapter matching a given parameter class.

methods.name: wrapExceptionInErrorResponse
methods.description: Wraps certain exceptions into standardized error response objects.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a Jsonifiable object into an Optional of Adaptable, using reflection to invoke the appropriate method.

methods.name: invokeToAdaptable
methods.description: Helps invoke the 'toAdaptable' method via reflection and handle potential exceptions.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Generates a Markdown file containing the JSON example, wrapped and formatted appropriately.

methods.name: removeNonRegularFieldsFromValue
methods.description: Filters out non-regular (hidden or special) fields from the JSON object.

methods.name: wrapCodeSnippet
methods.description: Wraps a JSON string in Markdown code block syntax with optional titles.

methods.name: resolveTitle
methods.description: Determines the title for the Markdown snippet based on the Jsonifiable object.

methods.name: resolveFileName
methods.description: Determines the filename for the generated markdown based on the title and Jsonifiable object.
